description: This file defines the OrderService class which manages checkout and order management functionalities, including creating orders, validating stock, handling addresses, listing user orders, and retrieving specific orders. It interacts with database models and external cart service.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling checkout processes, order creation, validation, and retrieval of user orders.

methods.name: __init__(self, db: Session)
methods.description: Initializes the OrderService with a database session and creates an instance of CartService.

methods.name: models.Order checkout(self, user_id: int, method: str, address)
methods.description: Performs checkout by creating an order, validating stock, creating address records, updating stock quantities, and clearing the cart.

methods.name: list_user_orders(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves all orders for a specific user, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: Optional[models.Order] get_user_order(self, user_id: int, order_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order for a user by order ID.

ctags.name: checkout
ctags.pattern: /^    def checkout(self, user_id: int, method: str, address) -> models.Order:$/

ctags.name: get_user_order
ctags.pattern: /^    def get_user_order(self, user_id: int, order_id: int) -> Optional[models.Order]:$/
